question: Which section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 corresponds to Section 413 of the Indian Penal Code (Habitually dealing in stolen property)?

question: How does Section 417 of the Indian Penal Code (Punishment for cheating) compare with its counterpart under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita?

question: Which section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 corresponds to Section 450 of the Indian Penal Code (House-trespass in order to commit offence punishable with imprisonment for life)?
